description: Mixed solid-cystic mass arising from the fourth ventricle and causing mass effect on the brainstem. There was also resultant obstructive hydrocephalus, not shown here. The mass appears to ‘ooze’ out of the foramen of Magendie. There was no associated spinal lesion. Classical ‘plastic’ ependymoma.
